name: Supermemory
summary: Supermemory is a memory API that extracts and consolidates context from files, chats and URLs into a vector-graph store and injects it into model context. It offers a hosted API, an MCP server and plugins for coding agents, plus a single-binary local mode.
facts: Hosted API; local binary or Docker; self-hosting on Scale and Enterprise
goodFor: Memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor via MCP
Ingesting documents and connectors alongside chats
Switching between local and hosted with one SDK
watchOut: Product direction has shifted (company brain discontinued Sept 2026, then open-sourced)
Benchmark claims are not given with comparable numbers
Local mode's URL ingestion still uses a hosted service
